description.value: The Totems site near Kispiox is an outdoor cultural heritage attraction showcasing traditional Gitksan totem poles in one of six ancient Gitksan communities estimated to be roughly 3,000 years old. Located in the Skeena River valley, Kispiox sits within Anspayaxw territory and is a recognized stop on touring routes through northwest British Columbia. The totem poles represent a living cultural tradition of the Gitksan people and offer a meaningful historical waypoint for cyclists exploring the region.
